recoil.description: Recoil: Each shot lifts the camera by the degrees of the weapon's row, else of its weapon group.

recoilGroups.description: Per weapon group: Degrees per shot for every weapon of the group. A group without a row has no recoil.

pitch.description: Kick: Degrees the camera goes up per shot.

recoilWeapons.description: Per weapon: A weapon listed here uses its own kick instead of its group's.

pitch.description: Kick: Degrees the camera goes up per shot.

driveBySpeedLimit.description: Speed limit: Nobody aims from a vehicle going faster than the speed below (not in separate worlds such as instanced interiors).

driveBySpeed.description: No aiming above: 12 m/s is about 43 km/h.

driveByModels.description: Vehicle lists: Uses the two vehicle lists below.

noAimModels.description: Front seats cannot aim: Vehicle model names whose driver and front passenger cannot aim (armoured trucks).

noLookBackModels.description: No shooting backwards: Vehicle model names nobody inside can shoot backwards from (low sports cars).

hoodBlocksFire.description: Open hood and trunk block shots: Nobody shoots forward through an open hood or backwards through an open trunk.

noCoverFire.description: No blind fire from cover: A player in cover shoots only while aiming, and a see-through (ghosted) player cannot shoot at all.

aimToFire.description: Aim to fire: On foot nobody shoots or hits with a melee weapon or fists without holding the aim key (right mouse).

noCombatRoll.description: No combat roll: With a weapon aimed the jump key does not roll.

antiStrafe.description: Break A / D macros: Tapping A and D very fast while aiming (a strafe macro) is broken by a short forced step.

strafeTaps.description: Taps that count as a macro: More A / D presses than this within one second while aiming break the strafe.

strafeBreakMs.description: Forced step: How long the player is pushed sideways.

meleeDamage.description: Change player melee damage: The listed weapons do the percent below of GTA's damage. Off keeps GTA's own damage.

meleeDamagePercent.description: Melee weapon damage: Percent of GTA's normal damage: 100 is unchanged, 25 hits four times softer.

meleeWeapons.description: Melee weapons: GTA weapon names the damage applies to.
